$description: One template per distinct page shape (27 shapes for 35 routes). Every node carries exactly section, variants, required and repeatable; the semantic validator matches PageSpec nodes on (section, variant) against this list, in order. sourceStatusAtExtraction 'in-flight' marks product pages that other agents were still building while this repo was extracted: those templates are grounded in the Playwright-measured specs (evidence spec-measured) and must be re-diffed against src/ before relying on them.

routing.outOfScopeNote: Blog, customer stories, integrations, product updates, webinars and previous-terms pages were removed on purpose and must NOT be recreated. Links to them are absolute https://www.siena.cx URLs (src/routes.js siteHref).
